lina_cs: Heads-up — customer ACME reported per-model throughput graphs in Console went flat at ~15:04 UTC after our metrics relabel rollout. Tickets: #INC-4891. See snapshot: https://redwood.console/incident/INC-4891 :warning:

joe_support: Thanks. Customer experiencing no impact to inference but dashboards show 0 qps per-model? Any API errors? Which exporter change was deployed?

lina_cs: No API errors reported. They still get responses; just graphs show flatline. Deployed relabel maps for prometheus-exporter to rename label 'model' -> 'model_name' around 15:02. Likely mismatch.

maya_engineer: Can you paste the exact relabel config? Also sending grafana panel query.

lina_cs: relabel snippet:
```
- source_labels: [__name__, model]
  regex: 'redwood_per_model_qps;(.*)'
  target_label: 'model_name'
```
(not exact YAML but gist).

tom_oncall: quick check: run curl against /metrics on one exporter pod to see labels.

joe_support: I ran quick promql: `sum(rate(redwood_per_model_qps[1m])) by (model)` returns nothing, `by (model_name)` returns numbers. So dashboards still query `model` label.

maya_engineer: ack. Dashboard panels use `label_replace`? Probably hardcoded. We'll need either a compatibility relabel or update dashboards.

tom_oncall: Workaround: add a relabel to Prometheus scrape to map model_name back to model:
```
relabel_configs:
- source_labels: [model_name]
  regex: '(.*)'
  target_label: 'model'
  replacement: '$1'
```
— will recreate the old label.

lina_cs: Customer on the line; can we enable quick compat relabel in prod?

maya_engineer: I'll patch the Prometheus scrape config via k8s configmap and roll a restart to pick it up. ETA 12 mins. Also will open a console job to update panels to use `model_name` as medium-term fix.

joe_support: Noted. Sending customer a note: temporary fix rolling, update in ~15m. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Deploy started by maya_engineer at 1991234576 for prometheus-scrape-config-prod (rolling restart).

maya_engineer: Done. Verified with `promtool check config` then `kubectl rollout restart deploy/prometheus-server`. Prometheus now shows `model` again. Query `sum(rate(redwood_per_model_qps[1m])) by (model)` returning numbers. Please confirm dashboards back to normal.

lina_cs: Customer confirmed graphs returning. Closing escalation after final check. Opening follow-up to update dashboards and add backward-compat relabeling to exporter for future. INC-4891 -> resolved. :white_check_mark:
